decoder.prompt: Not technical? Here's what these actually mean
decoder.intro: All five exams are hands-on, terminal-open, clock-running. In plain terms:
items: CKA — keeps Kubernetes platforms running and fixes them when they break
CKAD — builds and ships applications on Kubernetes the right way
CKS — secures the platform: secrets, policies, hardening, supply chain
KCNA + KCSA — solid grasp of the cloud-native ecosystem and its security
decoder.punchline: Yes, it's harder than it looks on LinkedIn.

incident.title: Production is down. Now what?
incident.intro: A 15-second tour of how I actually handle an incident:

steps.text: Alert fires. Acknowledge fast, assess blast radius. No panic.
Plain-language update to stakeholders: impact, ETA, next update time.
Rollback first if possible, debug after. Small, reversible steps.
Blameless postmortem. Fix the system, not the person. MTTR goes down.

incident.punchline: Root cause: someone deployed on a Friday. (Kidding. Mostly.)
